note: item ids are rewritten to the positional form Bifrost mints; every other byte is verbatim. `error_case.frames` is the stream as it stood when the upstream broke, before the terminal event the original would have appended and Bifrost does not send.

cases.name: plain text with a terminal usage report
reasoning opens its own item before the answer
a tool call opens an item whose opening frame has no arguments yet
a truncated turn ends on response.incomplete
silent and unknown events produce no frames
